definitions.meaning: có khả năng đồng cảm, thấu hiểu cảm xúc của người khác

examples: A good teacher needs to be empathetic towards their students.
She's very empathetic — she always knows when something is wrong.

definitions.meaning: kiên cường, có khả năng phục hồi sau khó khăn

examples: She's incredibly resilient — she bounced back quickly after losing her job.
Children are often more resilient than adults give them credit for.

definitions.meaning: hay thao túng, điều khiển người khác vì lợi ích cá nhân

examples: He was manipulative, always twisting the truth to get what he wanted.
She cut ties with her manipulative ex-partner after years of emotional abuse.

definitions.meaning: tận tâm, làm việc cẩn thận và có trách nhiệm

examples: She's a conscientious worker who always double-checks her reports.
Being conscientious about deadlines is one of his strongest qualities.

definitions.meaning: kiêu ngạo, tự cao tự đại, coi thường người khác

examples: He was too arrogant to admit that he had made a mistake.
Her arrogant attitude made it difficult for others to approach her.

definitions.meaning: hướng nội, thích ở một mình hoặc trong nhóm nhỏ hơn là đám đông

examples: As an introverted person, she prefers a quiet dinner with close friends over big parties.
Being introverted doesn't mean being shy — he's confident but simply recharges alone.

definitions.meaning: bốc đồng, hay hành động mà không suy nghĩ trước

examples: He made an impulsive decision to quit his job without another one lined up.
Her impulsive nature often lands her in trouble.

definitions.meaning: hào phóng, sẵn sàng chia sẻ thời gian, tiền bạc hoặc công sức với người khác

examples: She's always generous with her time, helping colleagues even when she's busy.
He made a generous donation to the local food bank.

definitions.meaning: bi quan, có xu hướng nhìn nhận mọi việc theo hướng tiêu cực

examples: He's so pessimistic that he always expects the worst to happen.
Try not to be pessimistic — things might work out better than you think.

definitions.meaning: cứng đầu, không chịu thay đổi ý kiến hoặc hành động dù có áp lực

examples: She's too stubborn to apologise, even when she knows she's wrong.
His stubborn refusal to compromise caused the deal to fall apart.

definitions.meaning: có sức hút, thu hút sự chú ý và tình cảm của người xung quanh một cách tự nhiên

examples: The charismatic leader could inspire a room full of strangers within minutes.
She has a charismatic personality that draws people to her.

definitions.meaning: hay thù vặt, muốn trả thù khi cảm thấy bị tổn thương hay bất công

examples: After losing the case, he became vindictive and tried to ruin the lawyer's reputation.
Her vindictive behaviour pushed away everyone who cared about her.

definitions.meaning: sự chính trực, phẩm chất trung thực và tuân thủ nguyên tắc đạo đức

examples: She refused the bribe, demonstrating her integrity even under pressure.
A leader with integrity earns lasting respect from their team.

definitions.meaning: giàu lòng trắc ẩn, quan tâm sâu sắc đến nỗi đau khổ của người khác

examples: The nurse was compassionate with elderly patients who were frightened.
A compassionate response can make all the difference in a crisis.

definitions.meaning: tự ái thái quá, luôn đặt bản thân làm trung tâm và thiếu quan tâm đến người khác

examples: His narcissistic behaviour meant every conversation had to be about him.
Living with a narcissistic partner can be emotionally exhausting.

definitions.meaning: chăm chỉ, cần cù và kiên trì trong công việc

examples: She's a diligent student who never misses a deadline.
His diligent efforts over the years finally paid off with a promotion.

definitions.meaning: hay thay đổi tâm trạng đột ngột, khó đoán về cảm xúc

examples: The chef was talented but temperamental — he'd snap at the staff over minor mistakes.
Living with someone so temperamental requires a lot of patience.

definitions.meaning: có tham vọng, mong muốn thành công và sẵn sàng nỗ lực để đạt được mục tiêu

examples: She's ambitious — she already has a five-year career plan at age 22.
Being ambitious is admirable, as long as you don't step on others to get ahead.

definitions.meaning: thụ động-công kích, thể hiện sự tức giận hoặc không hài lòng một cách gián tiếp thay vì nói thẳng

examples: Instead of speaking up, he gave passive-aggressive comments like 'Fine, do whatever you want.'
Her passive-aggressive texts made the argument even more frustrating.

definitions.meaning: thẳng thắn, nói thẳng ý kiến một cách rõ ràng và tự tin mà không vòng vo

examples: I appreciate her forthright manner — she always tells you exactly what she thinks.
He gave a forthright answer instead of the vague response everyone expected.

definitions.meaning: có kỷ luật tự giác, kiểm soát được hành vi của bản thân để theo đuổi mục tiêu

examples: You need to be self-disciplined to work from home without distraction.
Her self-disciplined routine — exercising every morning — impressed the whole team.

definitions.meaning: nhỏ nhen, quá bận tâm đến những chuyện vặt vãnh hoặc hay để bụng những điều không đáng

examples: It's petty to hold a grudge over something that happened years ago.
She refused to share the credit — it was a petty move that damaged her reputation.

definitions.meaning: linh hoạt, dễ thích nghi với hoàn cảnh hoặc môi trường mới

examples: She's highly adaptable and settled into the new city within a week.
Being adaptable is one of the most valuable traits in a rapidly changing workplace.

definitions.meaning: hay lừa dối, có xu hướng che giấu sự thật hoặc nói dối để đạt mục đích

examples: She discovered he had been deceitful about his finances throughout their relationship.
His deceitful tactics in business eventually cost him all his clients.

definitions.meaning: thích giao tiếp xã hội, hướng ngoại và cảm thấy thoải mái khi ở cùng đám đông

examples: He's so gregarious that he strikes up a conversation with anyone he meets.
Her gregarious nature made her the heart of every social gathering.
